topFindings.title: Skinned meshes force obj.world=identity; placement comes ONLY from the bone palette
topFindings.evidence: Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.cpp:4556-4557 sets obj.world to identity for every skinned mesh (static uses mesh->WorldXfm() at :4559). Placement is derived solely from BoneOffsetAt(b)*boneTrans->WorldXfm() read from mesh->GeomOwner() (:3849, :4876). When placement is applied via SetWorldXfm on a parent Dir/group that is not the bones' TransParent, the palette resolves at the origin and the object collapses to one point.

topFindings.title: The fault is already patched three times with per-mesh-name one-offs (hub bar, scrollbar thumb, crowd rebind)
topFindings.evidence: Hub bar hack Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.cpp:4486-4492/4551-4555 ('SetWorldXfm lands on the mesh/labelDir but NOT on the bones parent chain -> ORIGIN'); scrollbar thumb hack :4516-4550; crowd RebindCrowdCharBonesToOwnSkeleton Crowd.cpp:906-1040 (latched once :1026, called at draw :409). Same bug, three call sites.

topFindings.title: Crowd 3D characters read a SHARED GeomOwner skeleton -> all instances at last-posed point, not animating
topFindings.evidence: Crowd.cpp:323-422 draws skinned 3D chars via curChar->SetWorldXfm(spXfm) (:403); engine reads owner bones not drawn-instance bones (Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.cpp:3849/4849). Documented shared-owner collapse Crowd.cpp:860-1040. 2D-imposter path (static billboard, MultiMesh.cpp:206) is correct and NOT the bug.

topFindings.title: Per-instance object-uniform slot machinery is correct (a0f98ad collapse regression genuinely fixed)
topFindings.evidence: Rnd_Wgpu_RB3.cpp:4433-4471 hands each draw of the same mesh a distinct UniformSlot with its own objUB+bind group (:4571-4586). MiloXfmToColMajor (:157-163) has no transpose bug. Static placement path is sound.

topFindings.title: 'Only some band members placed' is a game-side waypoint/data gap, not the transform engine
topFindings.evidence: Band uses Character::Teleport -> SetLocalXfm(way->WorldXfm()) (Character.cpp:485-490) which propagates through the normal LocalXfm->WorldXfm chain correctly. Members mislocated are those whose BandConfiguration/BandWardrobe waypoint (BandConfiguration.cpp:43-54, FindTarget) never resolved/fired. Drum kit is a bone-attached prop (BandCharacter.cpp:775) -> same skinned-identity collapse.

refactorRecs: Fix the skinned-placement contract centrally in BandRnd::DrawMesh and retire the 3 name-scoped hacks: either compose obj.world=mesh->WorldXfm() for skinned meshes with bind-relative bone matrices (Wii semantics), or generalize the translation-injection into a geometry-keyed rule (not mesh-name).

Eliminate shared-GeomOwner cross-world/prop skeleton aliasing for crowd and instruments so the latched RebindCrowdCharBonesToOwnSkeleton workaround becomes unnecessary; read the drawn mesh's own bones when it has them.
Close the band-waypoint data gap independently: assert in BandConfiguration::SyncPlayMode that every TargTransform.targName resolves to a BandCharacter and log misses.

Add a per-draw-path placement regression gate over the rb3-native HTTP API (/api/dta/eval position dumps + /api/screenshot centroid spread), with A/B via RB3_NO_CROWD_REBIND / RB3_NO_HUB_BAR_PLACEMENT_FIX / RB3_SCROLLBAR_THUMB_FIX_OFF so a correct central fix makes all three opt-outs no-ops.

bugRootCauseHypotheses.bug: Crowd characters all at one point
bugRootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: 3D-char crowd is skinned -> obj.world identity -> placement from a shared GeomOwner skeleton; every instance reads the last-posed owner bones. Latched per-owner rebind binds to only the first archetype. (2D imposters place fine.)

Drum kit/instruments are bone-attached (skinned) prop meshes (BandCharacter.cpp:775); obj.world forced identity and prop bones resolve to origin -> whole kit collapses. Same systemic skinned-placement fault as the hub bar/scrollbar hacks.

bugRootCauseHypotheses.bug: Only some band members placed correctly
bugRootCauseHypotheses.hypothesis: Band placement via Character::Teleport->SetLocalXfm propagates correctly; the mislocated members are those whose waypoint/Teleport never fired (BandConfiguration/BandWardrobe FindTarget/config-index data gap). Independent of the engine transform path.

One systemic fault (skinned meshes ignore the RndTransformable parent chain; obj.world=identity, placement only from bone palette) with 4 manifestations (hub bar, scrollbar thumb, crowd, drum kit), plus one independent game-side data gap (band waypoints).
